subject: SIG/SOC2 evidence: SSO/SCIM/RBAC delivery playbook
messages:
From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@echomedical.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@echomedical.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG + SOC2

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the intro — Echo Medical is running a SIG questionnaire and preparing for our annual SOC 2 assessment. Our auditor asked for a compact package covering access controls for the Redwood instance that Echo uses. Can you please provide the following artifacts: 

- Sample SAML assertions (2 examples, one interactive login and one service-to-service)
- SCIM provisioning delta log for the last 30 days (redactable)
- RBAC owner matrix / entitlement mapping for our tenant (role -> owner)
- Service account inventory and last rotation timestamps
- Description of least-privilege enforcement and exception handling (breakglass / approvals)

Target delivery: two weeks from today (11/11/2026). If that timeline is tight, please propose alternatives. Also let us know preferred delivery mechanism (encrypted S3, secure SharePoint, or portal upload).

We will want an index file listing the artifacts and a short note about what fields you redact by default. If you have a template SIG evidence bundle or playbook, please include it.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 20 min call if useful.

Thanks,
Amira Khan
Lead IT Compliance
Echo Medical
amira.khan@echomedical.com

--

(Attachment: None in this message)

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@echomedical.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG + SOC2

Amira — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Aditya (security), Grace (CS) and Ben (compliance) so we can coordinate.

High level: we can deliver all items you requested, plus an "evidence-index.csv" that maps artifact -> redaction notes -> delivery method. A few clarifying Qs to make sure we scope correctly:

1) Tenant scope: confirm you want artifacts scoped to echo-medical-prod (not cross-tenant snapshots).
2) For SCIM deltas: do you need every attribute change, or just provisioning events (create/modify/delete)?
3) Redaction: do you have a preferred PII masking spec (e.g., SHA256 hash vs. static redaction)?

Proposed workback:
- 11/01: Share evidence-index + transfer playbook (transfer-playbook.pdf)
- 11/03: Deliver SAML assertion samples + RBAC owner CSV
- 11/08: Deliver SCIM delta log (redacted) and service-account inventory

We prefer encrypted S3 presigned URLs for transfer. If Echo requires PGP-encrypted archive instead, we can do that too — we will need a public key.

Attaching a first-pass index (evidence-index-v1.csv) for your review.

Lauren Bishop
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

(Attachment: evidence-index-v1.csv)

From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@echomedical.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@echomedical.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG + SOC2

Thanks Lauren — that workback looks reasonable. Quick answers: 

- Scope: echo-medical-prod only.
- SCIM: we need provisioning events (create/modify/delete) and attribute deltas for identity-critical attributes (email, role, manager, account_state). Not necessary to include ephemeral attributes.
- Redaction: prefer hashed identities (SHA256) and timestamps preserved in UTC; remove IP addresses.

A few asks from our side:
- Can you mark service accounts clearly (and indicate if any have ownerless/unknown owners)?
- For RBAC owner CSV, include owner email and a last-owner-confirmed date if possible.

We will provide a PGP key for encrypted ZIP if you prefer that route — I'll share by EOD. Also, can you confirm whether SAML assertions will include the full assertion or a partial sample (we prefer full but redacted subject identifiers).

Amira

(Attachment: None)

From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@echomedical.com>, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG + SOC2

Amira — thanks for the details, this is straightforward. Couple of implementation notes from the security side: 

- Delivery: we will create time-limited, encrypted S3 presigned URLs (AES-256 server-side) and provide link expiry of 72 hours. If you send a PGP public key, we will also upload a PGP-encrypted tar.gz to the same bucket and share the presigned download link.
- Redaction: identities in SCIM will be replaced by SHA256(email) and we will strip IP fields. We will preserve UTC timestamps and include an attribute mapping document explaining the redaction.
- SAML samples: we will include two full assertions in saml-assertions-sample.txt. NameID will be replaced with SHA256(nameid) per your spec; attributes retained and labeled.
- RBAC owner CSV: we will add a last-owner-confirmed ISO date column. 
- Service accounts: we will flag accounts with no owner as OWNERLESS and include a recommended action (rotate credentials / create ticket).

Proposed delivery schedule (firm):
- 11/03 17:00 PST: evidence-index-v1 (final), saml-assertions-sample.txt, rbac-owners-echo.csv
- 11/08 17:00 PST: scim-delta-30d.log (redacted), service-account-inventory.csv

I'll attach a short transfer playbook with the S3 presigned link process and audit expectations. If Echo prefers SharePoint/OneDrive we can also do that but we'd need a guest upload URL.

—Aditya
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

(Attachment: transfer-playbook.pdf)

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@echomedical.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG + SOC2

Amira — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. We have the PGP key you promised (received 10/31) and will publish the first bundle via encrypted S3 presigned link today at 17:00 PST. Links + index will include SHA256 checksums for verification.

Deliverables today (11/03):
- evidence-index-v1.csv (final)
- saml-assertions-sample.txt
- rbac-owners-echo.csv

Remaining deliverables on 11/08 as Aditya noted. HubSpot note: I've linked the mutual action plan to the deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4981 (please confirm once you download so we can close the task).

If you prefer we can schedule a 20-minute handoff call tomorrow to walk through the samples when you have them downloaded.

Thanks everyone — will send the presigned URLs at 17:00 PST.

Lauren

(Attachment: none yet; links to follow)
